title: R2 audit remediation: contradicted/inconsistent admission gating, owner-action + missions cockpit integrity, strict lease-expiry validation
description: R2 remediation on audited R1 HEAD d3c5028 (correction BASE), still vs integration BASE 07f22db. R2-F1: AdmissionVerdict adds 'inconsistent'; scheduler-vs-driver lease reads are independent observations — material fence/state divergence while a scheduler lease is active-state yields OBSERVATION_INCONSISTENT (unknown, never a fault), with both raw leases retained as separate evidence; 'contradicted' now renders UNKNOWN / INCONSISTENT with conflicting fence/generation kept for diagnosis — only terminal-lease matches render 'historical/proven'; contradicted/inconsistent produce no active edge and no pass inference. R2-F2: OWNER ACTION branch gates the cockpit flag on cockpit observation integrity — scheduler-verified flags stay waiting; cockpit-only-unverified renders unknown/unverified with diagnostics; Missions panel gains an explicit per-panel UNVERIFIED label when observation_error is set (proved by a real Playwright route-interception spec). R2-F3: lease expiry validity is separated from lease state — confirmed-current claims require recognized active state AND a valid positive epoch-ms expires_at strictly after the observation time; null/NaN/Infinity/negative/past expiry on an active-state lease → unverified lease (unknown), applied consistently in deriveClaim, correlateAdmission, derivePass and the scheduler lease-held narrative. R1 regressions updated only where they encoded the defective null/NaN-is-active expectation. 62-scenario vitest (15 new R2 regressions) + 7 Playwright specs. Root test file remains the documented tooling exception; production scope stays apps/mission-control-ui/** — zero backend/authority changes.
